g.text: Recipients browse a temporary web page and download only the selected
bundles. Traffic is plain HTTP: a password is an access gate, not
encryption. Stop sharing to revoke access.
Ctrl+Shift+F focus | F6 next pane | Shift+F6 previous pane | F1 help | Enter continue setup | Y trace | Ctrl+K switch session | Ctrl+T new tab | Ctrl+P · Ctrl+Q
